solution:
**Given:**

Population of Chandigarh = 1090

Population of Kalka = 900

Population of Ludhiana = 1510

Population of Ambala = 2015

Population of Jalandhar = 1500

**Formula Used:**

Average population = (Sum of populations of all cities) / (Number of cities)

**Calculation:**

Sum of populations of all cities = 1090 + 900 + 1510 + 2015 + 1500

Sum of populations of all cities = 7015

Number of cities = 5

Average population = 7015 / 5

**∴ Average population = 1403**
